dialogues.speaker: Ulyana
dialogues.text: Huh, that little rascal's out again? I hope he won't run into any danger... Oh hey. What is it?

dialogues.speaker: Ulyana
dialogues.text: ...I'm just worried about my brother. He's the youngest of us, and came here from Nasha Town to become a Ratnik.

dialogues.speaker: Ulyana
dialogues.text: But he really is quite the rascal. Piramida isn't all that far from Nasha Town, but he keeps saying he can't come home because he's too busy.

dialogues.speaker: Ulyana
dialogues.text: I had to come all the way here to see him... Only to hear he's out on a mission again.

dialogues.speaker: Ulyana
dialogues.text: And I'll make sure to pinch his cheeks real hard then!

dialogues.speaker: Ulyana
dialogues.text: *Sigh* Of all the things in the world, he had to become a Ratnik...

dialogues.speaker: Ulyana
dialogues.text: ...Yeah. But it really doesn't feel good having to wait like this.

dialogues.speaker: Ulyana
dialogues.text: I should've stopped him when he said he wanted to join the Lightkeepers, but see, I figured he'd be back with his tail between his legs soon enough. I never expected him to stick with it through all these years...

dialogues.speaker: Ulyana
dialogues.text: So what can we do except pray for him...? Hopefully, he'll be back safe and sound.
